get.description: Every save, most recently played first (M7b: the Saves screen).

delete.description: Delete the save and its backups. 409 while it is busy.

post.description: Change the save's display name; the company name and the save's id stay (M7b).
Save as: a copy under a new name and id. 409 for an Ironman or busy save.

get.description: Periodic and pre-upgrade backups, newest first.

post.description:
Restore a backup as a new save, "Company (restored, Mar 2013)"; the original is
never changed. 409 for an Ironman or busy save.

get.description:
What drives the top bar's and Overview's numbers (M7b tooltips): fetched when a
tooltip first opens, so Continue does not pay for them.
Someone who has left (M7c): read-only, as the player knew them when they left.
Open searches, plus closed ones whose candidates are still available, newest first.

post.description: Interview a candidate; the response says what it taught (M4c).
Check a candidate's references; the response says what it taught (M4c).
The offer dialog's hint and rule checks. No energy, no randomness, nothing saved.

get.description: One message, archived or not, wherever it falls in the pages (M7c deep links).

post.description: Mark every message read (M4c). UI state: no energy, nothing in decision_log.
Archive every read message (M4c).
Archive one message; it is marked read too (M4c).
Bring an archived message back to the inbox (M4c).
Rename a department or team (free).
Move a team under a department or the company root (formulas.md 13.1).
Energy and one-off morale changes, by person, before a reorganization (13.7).

get.description: Plans that are not closed, by id, with what each delegate did last.
Categories and their segments, with today's addressable demand.

Every product selling in the category: owner, public scores, appeal, customers and
share of served customers, per segment; in the home region, or another (19.7).

The Products screen's tiles: MRR and its change, ARR, customers, hosting and
marketing this month.
The player's products that are not retired, by id.

post.description: Appeal and share* at a price against the current competitors. Nothing is saved.
Put a unit (or, with a null unit, the company root) on the product.
Refused with `launch_not_ready`, naming what is missing, below the thresholds.
Cancel a product in development: it retires at once and its units are freed.

The founder scouts every open candidate of the search (20 energy, formulas.md 11.12);
the response says what it taught about each (M4c).

get.description: P&L, balance sheet and cash flow for every closed month, quarter or year (14.1).

Cash, the projected net burn and runway ("profitable" when null), insolvency and the
game state (ADR-0018).
Holders, classes, shares and percentages; every grant with vested and unvested.
Seats, each director's confidence and trend, and the last quarterly meeting (14.6).

How the game ended: the reason, the turn, the last numbers and the last six months'
finance news (ADR-0018). Works on an active save too (game_state "active").
Every SAFE and bridge; an open bridge offer shows today's amount (14.7).

post.description: Investors answer at the next Continue, all or nothing (14.4).
The hint band (likely, uncertain, unlikely) and the rule checks. Nothing is saved.
The bridge's money arrives at this month's Continue (14.7).

get.description: Every round with its term sheets, and whether the next series is allowed (14.5).

post.description: Term sheets arrive at the next Continue.

get.description:
Every holder before and after accepting: the pool top-up, SAFE conversion and the
new preferred, computed with the closing function. Nothing is saved.

post.description:
The round closes at the next Continue; the other term sheets lapse. Where the round
adds a common seat, `nominee_id` names the founder's nominee (default: the most senior
employee; M4c).
Name an employee to an empty common seat (14.6, M4c; energy 2).

get.description:
The four macro indicators for the month the player is in and the 24 months before,
and whether a downturn is under way (20.4). Never a month ahead.
Every loan with its schedule and covenant headroom, and what each lender offers now.

post.description: Sign venture debt or a bank loan at once (energy 10); the money is in the bank now.
The first month's payment and the warrants for this amount. Nothing is saved.
Repay early, in part or in full, with no fee (energy 5).

get.description: Every rival: in your markets, all, or startups (15.5).
Rival moves and startup events of the last 24 months, newest month first (15.5).
Rivals' open offers to your people, answered at Continue (15.6).

post.description: The band now and after a raise to `salary_cents`. Nothing is saved.

get.description:
This month's events to answer (minor and major resolve to their first choice at
Continue; an open critical event blocks it) and recently answered ones (16.3).

Any written event, open or answered. The live state keeps only the last 24 months'
events, so an older one is read from its row (M7c: History links to old events).
The inbox message that carries an event's card (M7c deep links).

post.description: Answer an event: its effects apply at once (energy 0, 16.3).

get.description: Active storylines first, then ended ones, newest first (16.6).
Unit-mates and manager links with a label (16.7); never a number.
The org unit panel's "Team mood" line: strained or hostile pairs (16.9).
The save's holiday: running (months done, the date), or the last one this session.

post.description:
Start a holiday: one Continue a month until a stop reason (17.1). 409 if the save is
busy, the game is over or a critical event is open.
Stop after the month in progress; nothing is rolled back.

get.description:
Everything that happened to your company, newest first, with a summary line per
month. Search matches titles, bodies and names (case-insensitive).
Every month-end KPI, and each product's MRR and customers, oldest first.
Each storyline with its steps: month, title and the choice taken.
Records computed from history when the screen opens; shown values only.
Who answers, the engine's briefing (always available) and the last answers.

post.description:
Ask a question (at most coo.max_question_chars). Offline, over budget or after an
error the reply is "I can't think that through right now" with the briefing.

get.description: Divisions, support coverage, cross-division products and the executive team.
Staff with their fit and estimated effect for one seat (the Appoint dialog).
Each division's statement with its shared-services allocation (18.1); newest first.
The Offices screen: flexible HQ space and leases, and every city's indexes.
Rent, fit-out and an example market rate for a lease (the Lease dialog).

Where a product sells: status, prices, customers and revenue by region, reach, and
the builders' spread (19.7).
AI writing: the adapter, this calendar month's spend against the budget, models.

put.description: Change the adapter, budget (0 is offline play) or model ids; prices stay as they are.

get.description: Saved column views per table (M7b), shared by every save.

put.description: Replace one table's saved views and the view last used.

get.description: Everything the new-game setup screen needs (M1c).
Channel costs, energy and offer limits for the Recruitment screen (M1c).
Energy costs, unlock rule and options for the org screens (formulas.md 6, 13).

post.description: Skill values, points left and every rule broken. Never current ability.

get.description: Energy costs and launch thresholds for the product screens (formulas.md 6, 11.2).
Definitions of every KPI label and table column header (M7b tooltips).
